editor_overlay_push.contract: Layer editor over current screen via preferPush; V2 registration supplies the matching optional constructor parameter.

editor_v2_cursor_advance.contract: Advance every collapsed cursor by text inserted at or before its gap on its line; keep the existing multiline-input limitation.

editor_documents.contract: Expose typed immutable document/read-only metadata and synchronous rejected-save results independently of async or UI hosting.

editor_document_panels.contract: Expose read-only panel capability and panel factory with real workspace/document dependencies.

editor_async_save.contract: Expose asynchronous completion and host lifecycle methods without claiming any submitted durable write is cancelled by presentation detach.

normalization.restrictions: Only the 13 exact frozen raw IDs may replace CRLF pairs with LF. Preserve existing final LF; lf_added=false. No BOM/lone CR/token/comment/other whitespace rewrite. Raw and normalized hashes/counts are independent immutable goldens.

prerequisite_evidence.member: preferPush default and V2 third constructor argument

independent_expansion.notes: Strict independent whole-line expansion compared staged sources against independently normalized frozen raw bodies and member-spliced raw oracles. This is NOT the production renderer test or Java compilation.

production_renderer_regression.planned: All 120 membership/render goldens; all 72 supported source-only masks/432 render outputs; owner support/dependency negatives; normalization mutation rejection; isolated common-edit propagation. Actual core hashes are pinned separately from raw/normalized goldens.

java_compilation.reason: Parent owns Java/build coordination and complete class closure.

source_only_scope: These contexts prove individual source selection and rendering, not complete-project network acceptance, Java compilation, registry availability or runtime behavior. Public preset selections are not changed.
remaining_closure: SFMTextEditScreenV2 itself must guard the preferPush constructor and close behavior under editor_overlay_push.
Document models SFMTextDocumentSnapshot and SFMTextDocumentSaveResult plus their resolver/path/language/provenance companions need source ownership closure before editor_documents Java compilation.
SFMTextEditorPanelOpenContext, SFMTextEditorPanel and panel recipes need their precise member/feature closure before editor_document_panels compilation.
V1/canvas async consumers and their save-session types must be separately authored before editor_async_save runtime acceptance.
Keep current V1 registration/title/example contexts outside this six-file scope.
Read-only metadata API does not by itself guarantee each editor enforces it in its UI.
No genuine MC seam exists here; never use minecraft_version as a surrogate for a functional owner.
No general editor runtime, environment, snapshot selector, production Git lookup or feature inference is introduced.
